'''Krupx Munitions''' was a mid-sized manufacturer of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] weaponry. The company's speciality was the production of missiles and bombs, including MG-series ordnance and [[Seismic charge/Legends|seismic charges]] such as the [[Void-7 seismic charge/Legends|Void-7]]. Krupx also produced the multi-purpose [[VL-4a warhead launcher|VL-4a]] and [[VL-6 warhead launch system|VL-6]] warhead launch systems, which could fire both [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] and [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]].
